subject: Re: NebulaWorks onboarding — PO number, spend cap, and SKU line fixes
messages:
From: marcus_lin@redwood.ai
To: Leah Park <leah@nebulaworks.io>
Cc: monica_patel@redwood.ai, kimberly_park@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-10-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: NebulaWorks onboarding — provisional PO and spend caps

Hi Leah,

Thanks again for completing the onboarding packet. Attached is the onboarding form we captured and the provisional PO bundle we generated to get initial provisioning started. Summary: PO=2026-4512 (provisional), currency=USD, spend cap=USD 80,000, initial line items mapped to the following internal SKUs: NW-SKU-01 -> RI-GPU, NW-SKU-02 -> RI-STORAGE.

We noticed your invoice numbering convention uses a different SKU mapping — can you confirm the vendor SKUs you plan to bill against? If the NW invoice uses NW-SKU-01 and NW-SKU-01-ADD as separate lines that will be counted as two separate line items against the spend cap; if these should collapse to a single billing line we can reconcile on our side before finalizing the PO.

I attached the provisional CSV (PO-2026-4512-original.csv) and the onboarding form for reference. Monica and Kimberly are on Cc to make the final procurement adjustments.

Next steps: please reply with the SKU mapping you expect to invoice against and any currency/payment terms deviations. We'll aim to issue a finalized PO by EOD tomorrow pending alignment.

Thanks,
Marcus Lin
Head of GTM Ops
Redwood Inference
From: Leah Park <leah@nebulaworks.io>
To: marcus_lin@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-10-01T12:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: NebulaWorks onboarding — provisional PO and spend caps

Thanks Marcus — quick note from procurement at NebulaWorks.

We received your provisional PO but our billing system will emit separate line items for NW-SKU-01 and NW-SKU-01-ADD (they are semantically additive on our side). That will drive the line item count to 3 and appears to push the spend into USD 92,000 when converted from our contract currency (EUR). We expected the final spend cap to be ~EUR 75k (~USD 80k), but the conversion plus additive lines is the delta.

Is it possible for Redwood to either: 1) accept a small increase to the spend cap (USD 95k) to avoid refile, or 2) remap NW-SKU-01-ADD to the same internal SKU so the spend aggregates?

Attaching a snapshot of our draft invoice mapping. We also have a short PO template requirement doc if you need it.

Best,
Leah Park
Vendor Ops Manager
NebulaWorks

From: marcus_lin@redwood.ai
To: monica_patel@redwood.ai, kimberly_park@redwood.ai
Cc: priyom_das@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-10-01T14:10:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: NebulaWorks onboarding — provisional PO and spend caps

Monica / Kimberly,

FYI — Leah flagged two issues: (A) vendor will emit an extra additive SKU that will count as a separate line and (B) their contract is in EUR so the USD spend cap we generated underestimates the converted total. They asked for either a modest spend bump to USD 95k or a SKU remap to collapse the additive line.

Can procurement advise: do we have headroom in the vendor onboarding bucket to increase to 95k, or can we do a reconciliation rule to treat NW-SKU-01 and NW-SKU-01-ADD as the same spend key for PO usage only? If we go with remap we need the ledger and PO to reflect a single line so accounting doesn't double-count.

Priyom — tagging you for finance conversion guidance on EUR -> USD assumptions and temporary buffer treatment.

Marcus
From: monica_patel@redwood.ai
To: marcus_lin@redwood.ai, priyom_das@redwood.ai
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-10-02T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: RE: NebulaWorks onboarding — provisional PO and spend caps

Marcus / Priyom,

We reviewed the request. Proposal: issue a corrected PO (PO=2026-4512-R1) that consolidates the two additive vendor SKUs into a single spend line (RI-GPU) for the purposes of our ledger and spend cap enforcement, and keep the public-facing invoice line items unchanged. On the backend the PO CSV will map NW-SKU-01 and NW-SKU-01-ADD -> RI-GPU (quantity aggregated) so the spend counts against one line. This avoids reissuance delays for the vendor.

Currency handling: Priyom, we'll provision a 10% FX buffer on the provisional cap as a temporary measure for the first invoice cycle and reconcile after the first settled invoice. That moves USD 80k -> USD 88k committed buffer (still below the vendor's requested 95k). If vendor needs the 95k we can escalate to budget owners, but I'd prefer the mapping approach + buffer to minimize contract churn.

Attachments: I attached the revised PO CSV (PO-2026-4512-revised.csv) and a mapping snapshot (lineitem-mapping-snapshot.png).

Leah / NebulaWorks — Marcus will send you the revised PO file once we finalize. Please confirm you can accept the backend mapping (no change to your invoice file names or visible lines).

Thanks,
Monica Patel
Procurement Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments:
- PO-2026-4512-revised.csv (stub)
- lineitem-mapping-snapshot.png (stub)
From: marcus_lin@redwood.ai
To: Leah Park <leah@nebulaworks.io>
Cc: monica_patel@redwood.ai, kimberly_park@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-10-02T16:20:00-07:00
Subject: Finalized PO and confirmation request — PO-2026-4512-R1

Leah,

Thanks for the quick response and for the mapping snapshot. Attached is the finalized PO CSV (PO-2026-4512-revised.csv) and a short note explaining how NW-SKU-01-ADD will be aggregated into NW-SKU-01 for ledger/spend accounting. To summarize the decisions we captured:

- Finalized PO id: PO-2026-4512-R1 (replaces provisional PO-2026-4512 for onboarding/ledger purposes)
- Backend mapping: NW-SKU-01 and NW-SKU-01-ADD -> RI-GPU (quantities aggregated)
- Temporary FX buffer: committed buffer of USD 8,000 applied to initial spend cap (effective internal cap = USD 88,000) pending invoice reconciliation
- Visible invoice lines: no change to how NebulaWorks will present items to Redwood — this is an internal accounting mapping only

Please reply to confirm receipt and acceptance so we can close the onboarding ticket and move the vendor into active provisioning. If there's any procurement paperwork you still need (DocuSign copy, vendor W-9 / tax forms), include that in your reply and we'll prioritize.

Best,
Marcus Lin
Head of GTM Ops
Redwood Inference
